title: Folding step stool.
text: Folding step stool.. Folding stool folded up when being used resulting in user falling on floor. Well made product does not lock in open position.

product_metadata.title: YZWDTGS Non-Slip Folding Step Stool, Sturdy Safe Enough - Holds up to 350 Lb Footstool for Adults or Kids, Fold Ladder Storage/Opens Easy, for Kitchen,Toilet,Camping ect. (Army Green, XX-Large)
features: Lightweight Step Stool: The measurements of the plastic folding stools are 13.78" W x 15.94" D x 17.72" H, and when it folds,it is very slim and it can fit anywhere!

Strong Durable: Makes the plastic folding stepping stool safe for everyone,including kids, high quality&environmental friendly new polypropylene plastic. Can stand up for years of repeated use without cracking or breaking. Hold up to 350 lbs

Anti-slip Design: 49pcs unique rubber dots textured surface and anti-skid foot-pads design makes the folding step stool safe for everyone, including kids. Especially around the kitchen bar, bathroom areas.
Storage/Opens Easy: The folding ladder easy to use, It's quickly and easily folds away for convenient storage, just pull up the handle and push in the sides. Opens with one flip of the hand.

Convenient: This safety features making the step stool great for multipurpose uses i.e. bathroom, toilet, kitchen, office, garden, camping, fishing, outdoor and more. The step stool’s handle magically appears when the stool is folded flat. It’s light enough that your children will be able to comfortably carry it around so they can place it where they need it.
description: So Lightweight And Easy To Operate, The Kids Can Use It. There’s always that one item you can’t reach when you’re in a hurry, whether it’s in a kitchen cabinet or on a shelf in the closet. Then there are those times you need an extra step up, like in your RV and the SUV.  Makes a great gifts for anyone, Especially people with kids, Great for Kids Sink Use & Toilet Training. It's also can be used as an office foot stool. Your kids will be able to fold, unfold, and carry the stool around to wherever they need it without any struggle or constantly asking for help. Great for developing their independence. Stores Anywhere When the step stool is folded flat, it is less than 2 inches wide. That means you can store it anywhere you might need use it without taking up a lot of space: the kitchen, the bathroom, the garage, the kids' rooms, or riding in the trunk of your car.
